0022600206.text: The Grizzlies (6-3) come in on a three-game losing streak, though they are 4-0 on the road and sit seventh in the West, one game back in third place in the Southwest. Toronto (5-4) is on a one-game winning streak and is 2-1 at home, while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and the Raptors are without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Grizzlies lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
